pairing.title: Pair with your computer
pairing.intro: On your computer, open Navide, go to Account → Mobile App and choose Add phone. Then scan the code shown there.
pairing.cameraNeeded: Navide needs the camera to scan the pairing code.
pairing.notNavideCode: This is not a Navide pairing code.
pairing.waitingBody: Check that your computer shows the same six digits, then choose Trust this phone there.

error.rate-limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
error.invalid-code: This pairing code is not valid. Create a new one on your computer.
error.expired: This pairing code has expired. Create a new one on your computer.
error.bad-approval: The confirmation did not come from the computer you scanned. Pair again.
error.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

panes.empty: No panes are open on your computers.

notifications.empty: Nothing yet. You will see here when a pane finishes or needs you.
notifications.question: {pane} has a question
notifications.openWhileRunning: Notifications appear while the app is open.

settings.unpairHint: To remove this phone from a computer, use Account → Mobile App on that computer.
settings.revoked: This phone was removed on your computer. Pair again to continue.
settings.demoMode: Demo mode: showing fictional panes, not your computers.
